survivingClaim: PROVED (routine): for real combinations of two or more class traces of fundamental negative discriminants, sum_D c_D (sqrt|D|/2)^s L(s,chi_D) is a factor zero-free in Re s > -1 times sum_D c_D |D|^-1/2 Lambda(s,chi_D), with pairwise distinct generalised Dirichlet frequencies 2n/sqrt|D|, so no weighting gives an Euler or Eisenstein factor. R(x) - 1 = int_1^inf |f_x - 1|^2 dy/y^2 with f_x the weighted signed count of the divisor in the horoball Im z >= sqrt(Dmax)/(2y) (standard NB dictionary). MEASURED: off-line zeros for all fixed weightings tried; R about 28.3, 9.38, 6.75, 5.26, 4.76, 3.08 at |D| <= 20..1000; a block-permuted non-multiplicative control gives smaller values (1.4 to 2.1).
obstruction: Averaging over discriminants cancels nothing: every Heegner bracket is of Davenport-Heilbronn type with off-line zeros. The NB ratio is 1 + distance^2 to the constant in L^2(dy/y^2): non-increasing by definition, smaller for a non-multiplicative control, and blind to a Blaschke floor (< 1e-24 above verified height) at values near 3. inf R = 1 would imply RH; no step bounds the distance; nothing passes from finite spans to the limit.
controlsThatDefeat: block-permuted non-multiplicative control: smaller ratio (1.4 to 2.1) than the Heegner family
every averaged bracket is itself DH-type (off-line zeros measured, float64 winding, not certified)
lesson: Reject Nyman-Beurling span combinations whose only arithmetic is the choice of spanning family. Open and not attacked: density of the family under RH/GRH; non-fundamental discriminants.
refereeNote: Lemmas A, B, C correct in substance; horoball formula in the claim was inverted; the H4' cuspidal-energy statement is cited, not verified.
